name: energy_big_pad_pickup_from_empty
description: The car sits at rest on the big boost pad at (3072, -4096) with an empty tank, and takes +100 boost on the first step. Hand calc: Phi goes 0 -> 0.99999, so frame 1 pays gamma * 0.99999 = 0.9969; the 9 later steps pay the holding leak (gamma - 1) * 0.99999 each = -0.0279 in all; total about +0.969. At weight 75 that is about +73, half a Goal, for one pad pickup from empty.

expect.intent: a full-tank pickup from empty is worth about +1 of potential
x75 = about +73: one big pad from empty pays half a Goal
